title: Answer: intelligence is prediction and compression, which consciousness enhances

statements.text: Intelligence is the capacity to predict and compress data and achieve goals with minimal model complexity, as in AIXI and FEP-AI. Consciousness enhances it by iterative estimation of the system and its relation to its environment, conditioned on a causal world model.

sources.quote: consciousness has been proposed to enhance intelligent functioning by allowing for iterative state estimation of the essential variables of a system and its relationships to its environment, conditioned on a causal world model
